message:
fix(dlss): carry reversed-Z input convention through NGX feature flags

HistoryOwner copies reviewed scene depth unchanged (near=1, far=0), but
the renderer left SrConfig.depthInverted at false. Add an explicit depth
convention, reject unknown/mismatched inputs, and preserve conventional
depth for independent synthetic fixtures. Test both flags through the
production renderer route and the real P1 GPU input owner.
Unknown color remains guarded; no NVIDIA gameplay acceptance claimed.
